record.hypothesis: Replace absolute padded-slot position IDs with cumulative nonpadding position IDs, starting each observed sequence at 1 and keeping padding at 0. Preserve maxlen=128 and the final-real-position readout. Most histories are short; positions relative to the observed sequence may transfer better between training prefixes and inference histories than positions anchored to the padded window. Keep features, embedding table shapes, causal backbone, scoring, loss and optimizer unchanged; mirror position construction in inference.

category_rationales.rationale: Index positions from the start of each observed history using cumulative nonpadding counts, preserving padding at zero. This may improve transfer between training prefixes and inference histories for short sequences. Preserve maxlen, embedding shapes, final-real-position readout, causal convolutions, scoring, loss and optimizer. The generated predictor imports this model class, so inference uses the same position construction automatically.
